newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Megionneftegaz pre-tax rises to 775 bln rbls.
newsitem.headline: Megionneftegaz pre-tax rises to 775 bln rbls.

text.p: NOTES -- Russian-Belarussian joint venture oil holding company NGK Slavneft owns 60.5 percent of AOOT Megionneftegaz voting shares.
Megionneftegaz produced 12.47 million tonnes of oil in 1996, down from 12.84 million in 1995. The company forecast production would drop to 11.95 million tonnes this year.

These figures are not prepared to international accounting standards but were audited by Price Waterhouse to Russian accounting standards on an accruals basis, which differ significantly from those normally supplied in the West. Russian accounts are designed to meet the requirements of the tax authorities. Definitions of profit and assets differ significantly from those in the West, and converting Russian accounts to international standards can turn a profit into a loss.
Figures are not adjusted for inflation or the depreciation of the rouble, but the following data may be helpful.
